title: US aviation shutdown leaves four major airlines facing a $345 million hit after 18,500 cancellations
summary_full: On November 13, 2026, the aviation sector faced a massive disruption as over 18,500 flights were canceled across the United States. This chaos was triggered by the Federal Aviation Administration's ground stop due to a malfunction with aging communications technology. Major airlines, particularly American Airlines and JetBlue, struggled the most. Passengers experienced extended wait times and were eligible for refunds.
